subject.title: feat(extension): support session cache for volcengine

question: Should bundled Volcengine support opt-in provider-retained Responses session caching via `params.cache`, including `store` and `expire_at` semantics?
rationale: This is a new provider config and retained-response behavior, so code review can identify blockers but cannot decide the permanent product/security contract for bundled Volcengine users.

options.title: Approve guarded cache mode after repairs
options.body: Keep this direction open, but require a current-main port, full-input invalidation, tests, and explicit retained-response documentation before merge.

options.title: Move the cache mode out of bundled provider
options.body: Decline the bundled config surface and ask for a plugin or design discussion if Volcengine retained-response caching should be optional ecosystem behavior.

options.title: Close the stale branch and request a fresh design PR
options.body: Close this branch if maintainers do not want to spend review time on a large stale port before the product contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded cache mode after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep this direction open, but require a current-main port, full-input invalidation, tests, and explicit retained-response documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider seam and Volcengine entrypoint history makes this the best available owner for the bundled-provider product boundary decision.
